doc.snippet: Coziness System: Coziness meter implemented in game loop. Coziness value stored in GameState.coziness (0-100). Coziness value accessible from GameContext.

artifact.reason: Provides game state including coziness value. CozinessBar component will use `useGame()` hook to read `gameState.coziness` (0-100). Context provides `setCoziness` function for updates, but component only needs read access.
Defines GameState interface with coziness property (number, 0-100). CozinessBar reads this value from GameContext.

HUD component with three-section layout. Center section (styles.centerSection) is currently empty and ready for CozinessBar component. Component needs to import and render CozinessBar in center section.

Reference implementation for HUD component. Shows pattern: uses `useGame()` hook, reads from `gameState`, uses CSS Modules for styling, positioned in HUD left section. CozinessBar should follow similar pattern in center section.
HUD CSS Module defines styles for three-section layout (leftSection, centerSection, rightSection). Center section styles may need updates when CozinessBar is added.

constraints.constraint: Component Structure: CozinessBar component at `src/components/ui/CozinessBar.tsx`. HUD component at `src/components/ui/HUD.tsx` (already exists, needs update). Components use React functional components with hooks. CSS Modules for styling (CozinessBar.module.css).

State Management: CozinessBar reads from GameContext.coziness. GameContext provides coziness as number (0-100). Bar updates automatically when GameContext updates (React re-render). No need for local state if reading directly from context.

Gradient Implementation: Coziness value (0-100) maps to gradient colors: Low (0-33): Red #f44336 → Orange #ff9800. Medium (34-66): Orange #ff9800 → Yellow #ffeb3b. High (67-100): Yellow #ffeb3b → Green #4caf50. Use CSS linear-gradient or background-color with transitions. Bar fill width = (coziness / 100) * 100% (clamped 0-100%).

HUD Layout: HUD positioned at top of screen. Left section: Evening timer (Story 2.13 - already implemented). Center section: «Затишок» bar (this story). Right section: XP & Level + «Світлячки» (Story 4.1, 4.2). HUD styled with dark background, light text, warm accents. HUD always visible during gameplay.

Styling: Use CSS Modules for component styles (ADR-005). Gradient colors match UX design exactly. Light text color for label (readable on dark background). Smooth CSS transitions for value changes (GPU-accelerated). Bar fill animation uses width or transform for performance.

Ukrainian Localization: Label: "Затишок" (Coziness). Format: "Затишок" above bar, optionally "65%" inside or below bar. Ukrainian text added incrementally (Story 2.15 for full localization). Reference PRD FR40, FR41, FR42 for localization.

Performance: Use CSS transitions (not JavaScript) for smooth animations. GPU-accelerated transforms for bar fill animation. Ensure 60 FPS maintained during gameplay. No layout thrashing (use transform/width, not top/left).

Architecture Patterns: Follow naming conventions (PascalCase for components, camelCase for functions). Match file name to component name. Import organization: React imports, third-party imports, internal imports, type imports, CSS imports (at end).
